summary: The character value at diag(1, …, 1, N) on S is χ-part (a unit) times N^{k/2} per place; its N-adic size decreases in k.

steps.claim: det diagN(·, S) has component N at the places of P ∩ S and 1 elsewhere; after unfolding localChar, the claim compares, place by place, |ι(|N|_w^{−k′/2})| with |ι(|N|_w^{−k/2})| (the χ-factors are the same), which is monotone (gcongr) once each factor is compared.
Square both sides to remove the half exponents.
steps.lean: rw [← one_le_sq_iff₀ (by simp), ← norm_pow, ← map_pow]; norm_cast

steps.claim: At w ∈ S, |N|_w = N^{−1} (norm N, uniformiser N), and |ι(N)|_N = N^{−1} < 1, so the size decreases with the exponent; at w ∉ S the factor is 1.
steps.lean: split <;> simp [norm_locField_eq_q_zpow, h.2, h.3, norm_p_eq_inv, NeZero.one_le]
